project.title: Redesign of Corporate Marketing Website
project.objective: Redesign the corporate marketing website to improve brand consistency, UX, and lead conversion across desktop and mobile.
deliverables: Approved UX sitemap and page templates
Responsive UI design system and component library
High-fidelity mockups for key landing and product pages
Handover package for development with specs and assets
constraints: Visual identity must align with existing brand guidelines
All pages must be responsive and accessible (WCAG 2.1 AA)
Core templates must be ready within 21 days
Designs must be feasible for current WebCMS and front-end stack
SEO and performance best practices must be respected

risks.risk: Late alignment on brand direction causing rework of visual designs.
risks.mitigation: Run early brand alignment workshop and get sign-off on moodboards before full UI work.

risks.risk: Designs not implementable within current WebCMS and front-end constraints.
risks.mitigation: Involve web development lead in design reviews and validate components against CMS capabilities.

risks.risk: Scope creep from adding new pages and features mid-project.
risks.mitigation: Freeze MVP page list, track change requests, and negotiate trade-offs with stakeholders.

risks.risk: Poor mobile experience reducing conversion on small screens.
risks.mitigation: Design mobile-first for key flows and run quick mobile usability checks on prototypes.

themes.why_relevant: Multiple art directors must align on a single visual direction across all pages.
Web designers need to restructure navigation and content for easier discovery.
Reusable components reduce design and dev effort and keep UI consistent.
Layouts and interactions must work within the existing WebCMS and front-end stack.
Landing pages must support marketing goals and maintain search visibility.

backlog.task: Audit current website structure, content types, and visual inconsistencies
definition_of_done: Inventory of current pages and templates documented
List of UX and visual issues compiled with screenshots
Quick-win vs major-issue tags added
Shared with art directors for review

backlog.task: Define target sitemap and navigation for the redesigned website
definition_of_done: New sitemap drafted covering all core sections
Primary and secondary navigation patterns defined
Stakeholder feedback incorporated
Sitemap approved by art director

backlog.task: Create moodboards and visual direction proposals
definition_of_done: At least two moodboard options created
Color, typography, and imagery directions documented
Brand manager feedback captured
One direction selected and signed off

backlog.task: Design responsive layout templates for homepage and key landing pages
definition_of_done: Desktop, tablet, and mobile layouts created for homepage and two key landings
Layouts reviewed for accessibility basics (contrast, font sizes)
Art director review completed
Feasibility confirmed with web development lead

backlog.task: Build a UI component library aligned with the chosen visual direction
definition_of_done: Core components (buttons, forms, cards, nav, banners) defined
Usage guidelines documented
Components tested in at least two page layouts
Library shared with design and dev teams

backlog.task: Produce high-fidelity mockups for product and pricing pages
definition_of_done: All key states and variants designed
Content placeholders aligned with marketing
Mockups exported and organized in shared folder
Art director sign-off obtained

backlog.task: Create an interactive prototype for main user journeys
definition_of_done: Prototype covers homepage to lead form flow
Mobile and desktop flows linked
Prototype shared with stakeholders
At least one round of usability feedback captured

backlog.task: Run design review sessions and consolidate feedback
definition_of_done: Two cross-functional review sessions held
Feedback logged and prioritized
Decisions on conflicting feedback documented
Updated designs shared after review

backlog.task: Prepare design handover package for development
definition_of_done: All final screens organized and labeled
Specs for spacing, typography, and states documented
Exported assets provided in required formats
Dev team walkthrough session completed

backlog.task: Define content and imagery guidelines for future pages
definition_of_done: Guidelines for hero imagery, icons, and illustrations written
Tone and style rules for web copy outlined
Examples of good vs bad usage included
Guidelines shared with marketing and content teams

backlog.task: Validate designs against SEO and performance best practices
definition_of_done: Critical templates reviewed for SEO structure and metadata placement
Image and asset usage checked for performance impact
List of SEO-related design requirements documented
Marketing sign-off received

backlog.task: Plan phased rollout of redesigned pages
definition_of_done: Priority order of page releases defined
Dependencies with content and dev identified
Risks and rollback options documented
Rollout plan approved by project stakeholders

artifacts.title: Website UX and Visual Audit Report
artifacts.used_for: Summarize current issues and opportunities to inform sitemap and design decisions.

artifacts.title: Sitemap and Page Inventory Matrix
artifacts.used_for: Track existing and new pages, owners, and status across the redesign.

artifacts.title: Web Visual Direction and UI Component Guidelines
artifacts.used_for: Align team on visual language, components, and usage rules.

artifacts.title: Interactive Prototype for Main User Journeys
artifacts.used_for: Demo and validate the new experience with stakeholders and test users.

artifacts.title: Design Handover Readiness Checklist
artifacts.used_for: Ensure all specs, assets, and annotations are complete before dev handoff.

artifacts.title: Web Content and Imagery Style Guide
artifacts.used_for: Provide rules for copy, imagery, and SEO structure on new pages.

artifacts.title: Feedback and Design Decision Log
artifacts.used_for: Capture review comments and document final design decisions.

artifacts.title: Redesign Rollout and Release Plan
artifacts.used_for: Outline phases, timelines, and responsibilities for launching new pages.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on sitemap, navigation, and page priorities for the redesign.
threads_plan.trigger: Web designer shares initial sitemap proposal and page inventory for feedback.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the target sitemap structure and navigation model.
Confirm the list of pages included in the first release scope.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Select the visual direction and core UI components.
threads_plan.trigger: Art director posts moodboards and initial component concepts for review.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Choose one primary visual direction to move forward with.
Lock the initial set of UI components for the design system.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Review and iterate on key page layouts and prototypes.
threads_plan.trigger: Web designer shares high-fidelity mockups and interactive prototype links.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve homepage and key landing page layouts for development.
Agree on any final UX changes before freezing designs.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Finalize content, imagery, and SEO-related design requirements.
threads_plan.trigger: Art director posts draft content and imagery guidelines for comment.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the web content and imagery style guide.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Confirm handover readiness and rollout plan for redesigned pages.
threads_plan.trigger: Web designer shares handover checklist status and rollout proposal.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Sign off that designs are ready for development and agree on rollout phases.

channel_rituals: Daily async check-in where each person posts yesterday/today/blockers in one message.
Twice-weekly design review thread to share WIP screens and get quick feedback.
Weekly summary post capturing decisions, updated artifacts, and next-week focus.
Pre-handover checklist review thread before any major batch goes to development.
